levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: Branch 1 is Abu Bakr through Ali ibn Mushir and Ibn Numayr to Musa; branch 2 is Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr through his father (a relation) to Musa; the text writes Mus'ab and his father once, after the last «ح», so they are the shared tail (rule 3)
«قال موسى أما عافني» is Musa's own remark, not a link; «ولم يذكر ابن أبي شيبة» is a wording remark: both left out
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor gloss: left out
«أبي» is counted as the second occurrence of that word, since «ابن أبي شيبة» carries it first
